description: Defines classes, enums, and functions related to web requests, including request serialization/deserialization, MIME types, encoding, signatures, and authorization within the Thunder Web namespace.

classes.name: IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response body serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with type and hash value.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents HTTP authorization with type and token.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for serialization, deserialization, and management of request data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or body content into a stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream into the request or body.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Marks the end of serialization/deserialization process.

methods.name: Serialized
methods.description: Callback when a request has been serialized.

methods.name: Deserialized
methods.description: Callback when a request has been deserialized.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Provides a request object for deserialization.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Links a body to the request during deserialization.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a request object to its string representation.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to populate a request object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the request is valid.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the request to default state.

methods.name: Body
methods.description: Sets or gets the body of the request.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets the serialization mode.

methods.name: ScanForKeyword
methods.description: Searches for a specific keyword in a string buffer.
